items.title: Can AbbVie (ABBV) Justify Its Valuation After Raised Guidance And Strong Results?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) just raised its full year 2026 revenue guidance to about US$67.8b and lifted its dividend, after reporting third quarter sales of US$17.4b and net income of US$4.2b. Recent price action has been strong, with AbbVie’s share price delivering a 6.1% 1 month gain and a 17.3% 3 month share price return. Total shareholder return of 38.1% over 1 year and about 2x over 5 years points to momentum building around the raised guidance, pipeline updates and dividend increase. Scan other...
